title: Ocean Waves for Sleeping - Slow Waves in a Moonlit Cove, No Music | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of slow waves rolling into a sheltered sandy cove under the moon. Each wave swells and draws back softly over a calm surf, with no crashing breakers. No music, no seagulls, no talking.
The sea never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep, reading and study.
